topic: What antenna design considerations minimize signal attenuation in high-noise power line environments for reliable PLC integration?
consensus_response: Antenna design in high-noise power line environments requires careful consideration of array factor, impedance matching, and spacing to minimize signal attenuation and interference. The array factor optimizes signal coverage and reduces interference from nearby devices. Impedance matching ensures optimal signal strength and prevents signal loss. Proper spacing between antennas minimizes interference and improves signal quality. Regulatory standards like IEEE ensure interference prevention and secure communication. These factors work in concert to create a reliable and efficient communication environment for PLC integration.
